# AcquireOps

> Deal pipeline, underwriting calculator, and portfolio equity tracker for
> evaluating and growing a rental property portfolio.

AcquireOps helps real estate investors run the numbers on a potential
acquisition (cap rate, cash-on-cash return, the 1% rule, DSCR) before they
buy, track deals through a pipeline (watching, analyzing, offer made, under
contract, owned), and monitor equity and returns across an owned portfolio
over time - including a signal for when a property's return on equity is
low enough that a refinance or sale might free up capital for a better
acquisition.

Each user's data is private to their own account - properties, deal notes,
and equity history are never visible to other users.
